name: Strategic Planning / Southeast Task Force Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I
  Strategic Planning Committee I Southeast Task Force
  will conduct a Regular Meeting, at the following time and place,
  and will address the agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  2 Floor, Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, August 12, 2019
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1)  Public Comment
  a.  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item not listed on the agenda.

  2)  Welcome and Introduction

  3)  Discussion of Parking and Mobility in the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills

  4)  Activity and Feedback

  5)  Discussion on Date and Time for Future Meetings

  6)  Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task Force is
  scheduled for September 9, 2019.

  Huma Ahmed, City Clerk

  Posted: August 8, 2019

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
 accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
 (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least forty-eight (48) hours advance notice will help to
  ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the Council Chamber, is wheelchair accessible.
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning / Southeast Taskforce Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, August 12, 2019
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  August 12, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Julian Gold, City Treasurer Howard Fisher, City
  Manager George Chavez, Director of Community Development
  Susan Healy Keene, Assistant Director of Community Development
  Ryan Gohlich, Senior Planner Timmi Tway, Marketing and
  Economic Sustainability Manager Laura Biery, Policy and
  Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Susan Mishler, Isaac Gabai,
  Ed Brown, Linda Brown, Anne Laurenno, John Luca, Tiffany
  Saidria, Bahman Max Hakakian, Adonis Simmons, Sharon
  Persovski, Amir Dar, Abraham Assil, Howard Fisher, David Gingold.

  1)  Public Comment
   None.

  2) Welcome and Introduction
   Brief introduction from committee attendees.

  3) Discussion of Parking and Mobility in the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills
   Presentation by City staff
   Discussion between stakeholders regarding parking and mobility items in
  the Southeast area of Beverly Hills, including all modes of transportation –
  walk, bike, auto, transit, other. Staff provided information.

  4) Activity and Feedback
   City staff asked for residential input from those in attendance. Staff collected
  feedback.

  5) Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning / Southeast Task Force Committee is
  scheduled for September 9, 2019.

  Adjourn
  Date / Time  August 12, 2019 / 6:04pm
